description:
**File**: `src/services/fiber_tracker.cr:30`

**Severity**: P4 (documented race, fixable)

```crystal
current_peak = @@peak_fibers.get
@@peak_fibers.add(1) if count > current_peak
```

The comment explicitly says "The small race ... is acceptable for
peak tracking" — it is documented and intentional. A CAS loop would
fix it cheaply.

**Fix sketch**:

```crystal
loop do
  p = @@peak_fibers.get
  break if count <= p
  break if @@peak_fibers.compare_and_set(p, count)
end
```

This is a chore, not a bug — the existing behavior is correct
(peak is monotonic, only the exact value can be off by 1-N). But
the fix is small and would eliminate the documentation burden.

Found during code review 2026-06-18, see
`planning/code-review-2026-06-18.md` §5.2.
title: FiberTracker.peak_fibers has documented race (use CAS loop)
